name: Reworx
old_description: At Reworx, we create custom furniture and accents that merge sustainability with exceptional craftsmanship. By giving new life to reclaimed materials, we design pieces that transform spaces and tell meaningful stories. Committed to innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility, we combine timeless style with modern function to craft designs that embody both artistry and purpose.
about:
Reworx operates from Morris, Connecticut, with a shop in nearby Watertown. The company was founded by a family team, though the exact year is not publicly stated. The founders, referred to as family founders, built the business around giving new life to reclaimed materials, starting with barn wood mantels and expanding into custom furniture and accents.

The company designs and builds custom furniture pieces using reclaimed wood, primarily sourced from old barns. Its services include a design studio where clients collaborate with reclamation experts, a salvage and wood sales operation for DIY projects, and a mobile onsite design-install consultation service for both residential and commercial spaces. The workshop and studio handle projects of varying scale, though specific production volumes and headcount are not disclosed.

Reworx serves homeowners, interior designers, and commercial clients seeking sustainable, story-rich furnishings. Examples include residential mantle installations and commercial space consultations. The company also caters to DIY enthusiasts through its reclaimed material sales.

Reworx distinguishes itself by merging sustainability with craftsmanship, transforming discarded materials into pieces that carry narrative weight. The founders emphasize innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility, aiming to combine timeless style with modern function.
